summary: Thursday titles night for Craze & Crash: added a Nutella brand-backlash Short (4.6M-view breakout) and an Adidas vs Puma business-war Short to the feed, one title challenger and one currency proposal.
why: The core brand_backlash lane had no open topic; our 3 figure-free titles held 48-57% stayed to watch against 12-33% for the 3 figure-led ones (n=3 a side, so a test).

findings.title: On-niche breakout: 'What happened to Nutella?'
findings.detail: 4.64M views on 1.05M subscribers (4.4x), the only business Short among the market feed's 25 breakouts.

findings.title: Titles without a money figure hold better (so far)
findings.detail: Nokia 48.5%, Tamagotchi 54.3%, Toyota vs Mercedes 56.8% stayed to watch vs Stanley 29.2%, Swoosh 33.3%, Dollar Shave Club 11.8%.

findings.title: Puma's 2025: sales down 13.1%, net loss EUR 645.5M; adidas a record EUR 24.8B
findings.detail: The payoff for the Dassler-brothers business war.

findings.title: YouTube's title A/B test is still long-form only
findings.detail: Not available for Shorts per YouTube's help page.

findings.title: Claude Code 2.1.332
findings.detail: MCP-served skills (beta), PreSkillShellCommand hook, freeze fixes; nothing to change.
